title: Bounds for an initialized register state
statement: Let $n,\ell,S,K,i,\mathrm{cnt},c,d,j,B$ be natural numbers. Suppose $n+\ell+S+2K+2\le B$, $i\le K+1$, $\mathrm{cnt}\le K+1$, and $c,d,j\le K$. Then the register state initialized with these values has every register at most $B$.
replaced:
Let $n,\ell,S,K,i,\mathrm{cnt},c,d,j,B$ be natural numbers. If $n+\ell+S+2K+2\le B$,
$i\le K+1$, $\mathrm{cnt}\le K+1$, and $c,d,j\le K$, then the register tuple initialized
with values $(n,\ell,S,K,i,\mathrm{cnt},c,d,j)$ satisfies the bound $B$ in every
register.
